title: OOPALGORITHM2 External Calibration App Features
body:
Users who install the OOP2 decoding apk for Libre 2 are presented with a message asking "OOPALGORITHM2 use app for calibration" when using for the first time and periodically afterwards. If they answer "yes" they will not be able to read the Libre 2 via Bluetooth which is the primary use case for OOP2.

This message appear to me to be erroneous, as it induces users to make a wrong choice (at least in the majority of cases) and in any case OOP2 is _not_ a calibration algorithm.

comments.body: I have trapped in this pit, although I knew how the system work. Please, make this understandable, if it is necessary at all.

This is indeed a problem. I have created https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/1835 that should fix this.

Thanks for reporting.
